description: Get the artists the user follows. fetch_all=true walks every page; limit/after page manually.

after.description: Artist ID cursor for pagination (from previous response)

fetch_all.description: Walk every page instead of one page (ignores limit)

max_results.description: Max items to return (default: SPOTIFY_MCP_MAX_ITEMS env or 50)

response_format.description: 'concise' = human prose, 'detailed' = more fields in prose, 'json' = raw API object

name: get_followed_artists
